description: §14.8.9 S441 round 4 (F1) — a lookup keyed by a protected value selects BY the secret, and that selection is protected all the way down: `[...h].map(c => L[c].v).join("")` rebuilds the hash from a character table. E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED after round 3: the key taint reached only the selected value's scalar part, and a static field read (`.v`) off it was treated as a primitive property, so this served the hash (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar, S441 round 4 review).
